description: Source file implementing the CopyingTexture2DWrapper class for handling Direct3D 11 texture copying and processing, including HDR metadata handling, within the media GPU pipeline on Windows.

classes.name: CopyingTexture2DWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps a D3D11 texture for copying and processing, including HDR metadata handling, within the media GPU pipeline on Windows.

methods.name: CopyingTexture2DWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the texture wrapper with size, output wrapper, processor, output texture, and optional color space.

methods.name: BeginSharedImageAccess
methods.description: Prepares shared image access; currently a no-op returning OK status.

methods.name: ProcessTexture
methods.description: Processes the texture by setting up video processor views, handling color space, and executing a blit operation.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the wrapper with GPU task runner, helper callback, texture, array slice, picture buffer, and callback for GPU resource init.

methods.name: SetStreamHDRMetadata
methods.description: Sets HDR metadata for the stream using DXGI format.

methods.name: SetDisplayHDRMetadata
methods.description: Sets HDR metadata for display using DXGI HDR10 format.
